competency_fulfillment.rationale: The instruction to arrange a given set is exactly the competency verb, and the keys are ordered lists rather than single values, so the pupil really does produce an ordering rather than pick a largest element.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The vice versa half of the competency is genuinely generated, not assumed: seed 46 and seed 603 request largest to smallest while seed 42 and seed 601 request smallest to largest, and set sizes range from three values up to the six counts listed at seed 605.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Reading demand is light, one sentence per item, and the ordering work sits well within Grade 3 place-value reasoning even where the values cluster tightly, as with 9409, 9404, 9410, 9394, 9401.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Two presentations coexist: an abstract list of numerals, and a collection context where counts belong to a stated number of friends, as in the storybooks counted by 4 friends. Both directions occur in both presentations.

competency_alignment.rationale: Harder samples differ by having more members and by clustering the values so that discrimination depends on the last two digits, rather than by inflating the magnitudes; that is ordering difficulty rather than an unrelated axis.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The ceiling is honoured and actually reached, since 10000 itself appears as a member at seed 500, seed 501 and seed 502, while the lower end includes three-digit counts such as 393 and 600.
